title: ceropegia media
intro: Ceropegia media, commonly known as the "String of Hearts" or "Chain of Hearts," is a flowering plant species native to South Africa. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing anxiety and stress, promoting sleep, and alleviating symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Ceropegia media are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. Research has identified the presence of flavonoids like kaempferol and quercetin, as well as alkaloids like ceropegine, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
